decisions.statement: A page being created is compiled against its type less the properties a generator fills.
The type a body is held to is narrowed and no diagnostic is suppressed.
The narrowing is written on the line the `satisfies` clause already stands on.
A page being created and carrying no `satisfies` clause is compiled as the page stands.
No import is added for the narrowing.
A page the change did not bring into being is held to its whole type.
Nothing here builds a program or reads a diagnostic.

definition: the type a page being created is held to, less the properties a generator fills
